descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-14 steps 1-4 + ER; TFA-92592 AC 2, 7, 8, 11 · “Save & Extract closes matching open tasks and records medication events. Generate does not run task extraction again”.

Candidate N19 · proposed S1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

'Restarted metoprolol this morning' becomes 'Restart metoprolol …' in the plan (3 of 3 Hospital), and a one-time dose becomes a new PRN order: read as orders, a double dose

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 8 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-14/S15

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S01 Hospital: Begin Encounter, step-2 dictation, Save & Extract, Generate, Post-Round (live AI)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Both entry paths reach the same place: 'Begin Encounter' on the Pre-Round tab and the Encounter tab open the same encounter view (dictation box, Save & Extract, Generate). (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 2; TFA-92592 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Bedside checks stay reminders, not findings: 'check for dysuria' never becomes 'reports dysuria'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 A medication already given ('restarted metoprolol this morning') is documented as performed, not re-ordered. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 No placeholder tokens appear in the note: {ADDRESS}, {PHONE}, [Today's date], [Physician name]. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T4 No dictated fact silently disappears from the note (Principle 2). (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician. The Hospital fixture patient has two open tasks (Follow up urinalysis, PT evaluation) and a held tracker row 'Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID' (held {day-1}, soft BP)

When Pre-Round: type the pre-round text and press Save Note; press Begin Encounter; type the encounter text; press Save & Extract and wait for its message; press Generate Note & Finish and wait up to 60 s; read the note, then the tasks and meds toggles on Post-Round

Then Save & Extract closes 'Follow up urinalysis' once, leaves 'PT evaluation' open, adds one chest X-ray task and takes metoprolol off Held. Generate opens Post-Round with the note. The note documents the metoprolol restart as done, keeps 'check for dysuria' as a reminder (no dysuria finding), has no placeholder token, and keeps every dictated fact. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs strings per checkpoint below. cp1 and cp3 also need a backend probe of rounding:get (task done flags, exactly one X-ray task, metoprolol row no longer held, with today's change). Dictated facts in the note (urinalysis result, 128/76, crackles, chest X-ray plan) are T4. Post-Round with no note and no message fails U10. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
